name: Pools of Vision
summary: Forsaken gather in the Pools of Vision, beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. Still waters and dim caverns shelter their enclave within the tauren capital.

sections.title: A Haven Beneath the Mesa
sections.body: The Pools of Vision lie beneath Spirit Rise, below Thunder Bluff's sunlit peaks. A cave path beside the bridge to the rise leads down into the grotto. Misty waters fill its shadowed chambers, where Horde spellcasters gather apart from the open-air lodges above.

sections.title: The Undead Outpost
sections.body: Forsaken make their base within the Pools of Vision. Undead priests practice shadowed arts, mages conjure arcane portals, and Defiler emissaries seek recruits for their campaigns in the Arathi Highlands. Whether tauren skepticism or the Forsaken's own preference for darkness brought them here, the cavern links Lordaeron's undead with their allies in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to the Pools of Vision?
aliases: how to get to pools of vision
faq.answer: Cross the wooden rope bridge from the lower mesa to Spirit Rise. The cave mouth is immediately to your right.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken living down here?
faq.answer: The cavern is the central hub for Forsaken stationed in Thunder Bluff. Its shelter keeps them from Kalimdor's harsh sunlight and gives them room for practices that may unsettle traditional tauren spiritualists.

faq.q: What services can you find inside the Pools of Vision?
aliases: what is in pools of vision
faq.answer: Priests and mages train and practice in the cavern. Defiler emissaries also muster soldiers for the war effort in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where do mages arrive when they teleport to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: A teleport or portal to Thunder Bluff brings mages directly to the sheltered waters of the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise.

angles.text: As Forsaken crossing Kalimdor's plains, you can find familiar shade, arcane resources, priestly guidance, and fellowship in this cavern.
As a mage, you arrive beside these secluded pools when you teleport to Thunder Bluff; the cavern anchors the arcane ley connections to the city.
